## Sunsynk Control
One endpoint for all inverter writes. **Off by default**: nothing is written unless the n8n env var `SUNSYNK_WRITES_ENABLED=true` AND the request sets `"dry_run": false`.
Only timer fields are allowed (sellTimeN, timeNOn/timeNon, capN, sellTimeNEn). Every write is read back.
Protect the webhook with Header Auth.
